business_trigger: A claim or ledger payment exists and an authorised person has checked the bank
primary_agent: finance prepares; owner/ops_admin verify (no agent may verify)
expected_frontend: Verification queue, invoice payments list, 'Confirm payment' button
expected_backend: verify_payment (ledger) and verify_payment_submission (claim) with outcomes VERIFIED, REJECTED, NEEDS_MORE_INFO, PARTIAL, MISMATCH, DUPLICATE

runtime_evidence: psql as ops_admin (SET ROLE authenticated, jwt claims role=ops_admin): issue_invoice -> issued; record_manual_payment 3,000,000 -> recorded, invoice partially_paid paid_minor=3,000,000 verified_minor=0, start_readiness.advance_verified=false; verify_payment -> 'verified', invoice status 'paid', verified_minor 3,000,000, receipt RCPT-THDC2Q, unlocked_milestone_id returned; repeat -> already_verified (idempotent). So the earlier 'missing GRANT' claim is FALSE now: has_function_privilege(authenticated, finance.new_receipt_reference) = true (migration 20260929120000 grants it). Same call as finance role (cf213a97..) and as member -> outcome 'not_found' (payment invisible via RLS, no money moves). PARTIAL: record 1,000,000 then verify -> status partially_paid verified_minor 1,000,000 receipt issued; second 2,000,000 verified -> paid, 2 receipts, advance_verified flips only at full amount; overpayment 2,500,000 -> 'overpayment'; same provider ref twice -> 'duplicate'. Claim layer as ops_admin: pending_verification -> request_payment_evidence 'requested' -> evidence_requested; verify decision mismatch with note -> mismatch; confirm with blank evidence -> no_evidence; confirm with evidence -> verified; again -> settled; reject needs reason (db:verify:paymentverify I). A verified CLAIM leaves invoice 'issued', paid_minor 0, advance_verified=false (verification of a claim is a record, not money). Duplicate reference: unique index payment_submissions_reference_key (case-insensitive, excludes rejected/duplicate) raises 23505 at insert - no verifier door ever sets status 'duplicate'. 'partially_verified' and 'refunded' are allowed by the CHECK but no function writes partially_verified. Segregation: the same ops_admin recorded and verified the payment with no refusal.
known_bug: None blocking. Vocabulary gaps: DUPLICATE is an insert-time constraint (409), not a verification decision; PARTIAL exists only at ledger level (partially_paid), the claim status partially_verified is unused; no four-eyes rule (recorder may verify own payment).
blocker: Two unlinked verification surfaces (claim vs ledger): confirming a claim does not pay the invoice; confirming a ledger payment does not touch the claim. Finance (human) role cannot verify at all - only owner/ops_admin, though the spec says 'Admin/authorised Finance'.
risk: Operator confirms the claim believing the payment is done while the gate stays closed; self-verification of money.
required_fix: Link claim->payment (create ledger row on confirm); add DUPLICATE/PARTIAL decisions to verify_payment_submission; decide segregation of duties (NEEDS_BUSINESS_CLARIFICATION).
validation_method: psql doors as each role; db:verify:paymentverify; db:verify:finance-w1

Still true: DUPLICATE only as insert error. Real PostgREST/browser click not driven; the role switch (SET ROLE authenticated + JWT claims) reproduces the same privileges the Data API would use, and db:verify:finance-w1/paymentverify exercise the real Data API (HTTP 400/403/200 evidence).

Payment verified path: M1 verified -> advance_verified=t (2.10). A project with unmet readiness and no override: not started (proven).
